notes.title: Boom Boomerang Update - V1.1
notes.content:
A number of changes to the game have been implemented, with a focus on making Boom Boomerang a more accessible and streamlined experience:

[list]
[*] Overhauled the difficulty modes to provide a wider range of accessibility and challenge.
[*] Made a number of graphical changes to render the game in a more vibrant and consistent style.
[*] Arcade levels have been restructured and ordered in a linear fashion, providing more straight-forward progression.
[*] The throw combo is now filled using a meter system which fills for each target destroyed. When the meter is full, the combo goes up by 1. Miss, and it goes down by 1.
[*] Onslaught now has three modes which affect the target spawn rate: Slow, Medium and Fast.
[*] Calibrate mode and the tutorial now include a throwing angle calibration mechanic to automatically adjust the angle of the player's throw based on their natural throwing tendencies.
[/list]

notes.title: Boom Boomerang leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
[b]Boom Boomerang[/b] is leaving early access and releasing officially today!

The early access period provided some time to address feedback and fix bugs. Now that that's done, Boom Boomerang can be officially released as version 1.0.

To celebrate, a new boomerang has been added to the unlockables: The Triangle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36373665/fc0c83923525f707e225c9cb7e9a27d171b2fcd8.png[/img]

In addition, Steam Achievements are now available, and a number of  gameplay changes and have also been applied. See below for the patch notes.

The soundtrack for the game has been made available [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xrg4neH6N14]here[/url].

A huge thank you to everyone who took part in the beta and Early Access periods. Any further feedback is always appreciated.

Patch notes: 

[list]
[*] Player now starts with multiple lives in both Survival and Arcade Mode.
[*] Modified the throwing and score system to make the game more accessible.
[*] Added new Boomerang, the Triangle.
[*] Updated trails and other visual effects.
[*] Added Steam Achievements (35 in total).
[*] Added Spectator Camera, available in the Display Settings.
[*] Changed Classic Mode to Survival Mode.
[*] Changed difficulty modes to 'Hard' and 'Normal'.
[*] Lowered the price of unlocking boomerangs and trails to make them more accessible.
[*] Various minor tweaks + bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Boom Boomerang V0.12
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who has purchased the game since its launch in Early Access! 

Several changes have been made to the game based on player feedback, and version 0.12 is now live on the default branch of the game on Steam.

[i]A quick note on branches: if you go to the game properties in Steam and click the 'Betas' tab, you will see a drop-down which allows you to choose various branches (versions) of the game. If you would like to try the latest version of the game and provide valuable feedback on the latest changes to the game, choose the branch called 'boomboomerangbeta'. Then join the discord (https://discord.gg/gMSmYMK) or post your feedback on the discussions board on Steam. If you would like to return to a previous build of the game, choose the branch with the relevant version number.[/i]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[b]Gameplay changes: [/b]

	* Tweaked the aim-assist to better balance the difficulty.
	* Slightly extended the countdowns for all targets in aim-assist.
	* Shuffled the rounds in Classic Mode so the first Boss is slightly easier.
	* Reduced the speed that the Boss sides bounce the boomerang back at you, and expanded the 
          'catch area' around the controller, making boomerangs slightly easier to catch.
	* Changed the scoring system in Classic Mode to include Throw Combo, however it resets after 
          each round.
	* Changed the Block targets scoring system to account for addition of Throw Combo in Classic 
          Mode.
	* Expanded the range of the Sonic Boom slightly.
	* All leaderboards have been reset for version 0.12. Old leaderboards should still be available if 
          you use the '0.11' build from the beta options in the game properties on Steam, but that version 
          of the game will obviously not be updated.
	* Unfortunately, any boomerangs or trails unlocked have also been reset for V0.12. However, 
          changes have been made in order to avoid this in the future, where scores and awards may be 
          reset but unlocks should be retained.
	* Boomerangs now increase marginally in speed relative to the Throw Combo. 
	* A pop-up notification saying "SONIC BOOM NOW!" now appears when the boomerang slows 
          down beside a missed target. This only happens if you hit a targets earlier along the curve and 
          only on the second-to-last or last target along that curve.

[b]Other changes:[/b]

	* Disabled pointer for menus on non-dominant hand (to avoid buttons not registering clicks due to 
          hovering overlaps).
	* Added 'Reset VR Orientation' and 'Reset VR Location" options to Display Settings. 
	* Added a 'Refresh Leaderboard' button to online leaderboards. 
	* Added 'Leaderboard Loading...' text to global leaderboards while Steam leaderboards load. 
	* Optimized Basic Training.
	* Other miscellaneous tweaks.

[b]Bug fixes: [/b]

	* Fixed audio issue where there is no sound except for music when game window is unfocused. All 
           audio should now play when the game window is not selected. 
	* Adjusted boomerang spawn in attempt to fix a rare bug where player suddenly cannot grab 
          boomerang, or where the current boomerang is not destroyed when a new one is grabbed from 
          the same hand.
